summary: This ASTA deep research document is a Patch-seq DATASET SURVEY, not a cell-type characterization report. It explains the Patch-seq method (paired single-cell electrophysiology + transcriptomics, sometimes + morphology) and inventories which datasets are available across the amygdala, medial temporal lobe (MTL), temporal cortex, and broader brain regions. It does NOT characterize specific amygdala/MTL cell types with their own markers, electrophysiology, and morphology in the detailed way required to mint KB CellTypeNode stubs. The only amygdala-specific cell content is a single statement that in medial amygdala (MEA) and basomedial amygdala (BMA), VGLUT2-class (glutamatergic) and GABA-class neurons intermix (Hochgerner et al., 2023) - no per-type markers/ephys/morphology are given. MTL relevance is asserted via hippocampal CA1 PV-Cre interneurons (Bomkamp et al., 2019; 19 cells, no per-type detail) and via human middle temporal gyrus (MTG) Patch-seq of supragranular glutamatergic neurons (Arbabi et al., 2022; 278 cells, mapped to the Hodge et al., 2019 human MTG taxonomy). Broad GABAergic interneuron subclasses (PVALB, SST, VIP, LAMP5/PAX6, double-bouquet/DBC, SST FRZB, SST CALB1) are described, but only in mouse/human NEOCORTEX (Gouwens et al., 2020; Scala et al., 2020; Lee et al., 2023) and mouse striatum (Munoz-Manchado et al., 2018) - none are amygdala- or MTL-resolved. No amygdala or MTL cell type in this document is characterized with the multimodal per-type detail needed for a KB node, so no proposed_types are emitted. The value of this document is its dataset inventory (see dataset_inventory.json), which identifies Patch-seq resources usable for annotation-transfer and evidence-upgrade workflows on amygdala/MTL nodes. Most of the 27 extracted quotes are generic method descriptions or out-of-region (cortex/striatum/motor cortex/primate) dataset abstracts.
